More about Stravous

How a project runs

Four stages, with regular progress updates from first meeting to handover.

  1. Consultation

    We meet to understand your vision, assess the site, and agree the scope and budget.

  2. Design and planning

    Our architects produce detailed drawings and our engineers build a full project plan.

  3. Construction

    Skilled craftsmen carry out the build under strict quality control, with regular updates to you.

  4. Handover

    Final inspections and quality checks, then handover with complete project documentation.

About Stravous Construction

Building Nigeria’s future, one project at a time.

From a small team of engineers to a trusted name.

Stravous Construction began as a small group of dedicated engineers. Since 2013 it has grown into one of Nigeria’s respected construction firms, with work that ranges from luxury residential estates to large commercial developments.

What has not changed is how we work: quality craftsmanship, transparent processes and a commitment to every client we build for.

Licensed and certified
Fully accredited professionals.
On-time delivery
Consistent project timelines.
Safety standards
No compromise on safety practice.
Premium materials
Top-tier materials, properly sourced.

Our mission

To deliver high-quality construction that turns our clients’ visions into reality, holding high standards for quality, safety and environmental responsibility, and building durable structures that serve Nigerian communities.

Our vision

To be Nigeria’s most trusted construction partner, setting the benchmark for innovation, sustainability and client satisfaction, and bringing quality infrastructure to every Nigerian community.

Meet the team

Every Stravous project is run by four groups working as one site team.
